passages.text: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head. I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever: yet have you brought up my life from the pit, Yahweh my God. “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
passages.note: feeling overwhelmed and drowning, then rescued through prayer

passages.text: Yahweh said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”
passages.note: questioning whether one's anger is justified
